summary: FarmVille entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: FarmVille
entries.definitive_edition: Original Facebook FarmVille service, documented as defunct

emulation.notes: The original depended on live Facebook/Flash service infrastructure.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Historical documentation only unless an official preservation route appears

primary.why: The original FarmVille was a Facebook/Flash social farming service, and Zynga discontinued the first FarmVille on December 31, 2020. There is no current official playthrough route for the original game; later FarmVille sequels are separate games.
primary.how_to_play: For the original FarmVille, archive as a defunct live-service entry: use preserved screenshots, videos, account records, official shutdown notices, and contemporary documentation rather than treating FarmVille 2 or 3 as replacements.

all_releases.fidelity: Original social-network service and historical artifact.
all_releases.reason: primary: only authentic route, but it is no longer officially playable.

all_releases.platform: HTML/MSN Games and brief iOS route
all_releases.reason: skip: unavailable historical variants; preserve only through documentation.
skip: separate games, not replacements for the original 2009 FarmVille.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The authentic service is closed, so archive completeness depends on preserved external evidence rather than a playable official build.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute FarmVille 2 or FarmVille 3 for the original social-network game.
